import { McpServer } from "@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/server/mcp.js";
import { StdioServerTransport } from "@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/server/stdio.js";
import { Ajv2020, type ValidateFunction } from "ajv/dist/2020.js";
import _addFormats from "ajv-formats";
import { z } from "zod";
import { replay } from "./replay.js";
import { replayInDocker } from "./docker-replay.js";

const INPUT_SCHEMAS: Record<string, object> = {"add_customer_note":{"type":"object"},"add_note_by_api":{"type":"object"},"refresh_the_list":{"type":"object"}};

// ajv-formats ships as CJS; cast to the callable form for TypeScript.
const addFormats = _addFormats as unknown as (ajv: Ajv2020) => void;
const ajv = new Ajv2020({ allErrors: true, strict: false });
addFormats(ajv);
// Schemas are compiled once at startup, not per call.
const validators = new Map<string, ValidateFunction>(
  Object.entries(INPUT_SCHEMAS).map(([tool, schema]) => [tool, ajv.compile(schema)])
);

// Returns null when the payload is valid, the list of violations otherwise.
function validatePayload(tool: string, payload: unknown) {
  const validate = validators.get(tool);
  if (validate === undefined || validate(payload)) return null;
  return (validate.errors ?? []).map((err) => ({
    instancePath: err.instancePath ?? "",
    schemaPath: err.schemaPath ?? "",
    message: err.message ?? "Validation error"
  }));
}

// DAEMONIZE_SANDBOX=docker replays every call in a throw-away container instead of on this machine.
const runReplay = process.env.DAEMONIZE_SANDBOX === "docker" ? replayInDocker : replay;

// DAEMONIZE_MODE=strict (the default) or heal. Every result says which mode produced it; a result that did not
// get as far as a replay (a refused payload, a sandbox that did not start) is completed here.
const MODE = process.env.DAEMONIZE_MODE?.trim().toLowerCase() === "heal" ? "heal" : "strict";
function withMode(result: object): object {
  return { mode: MODE, ...(MODE === "heal" ? { healed: false, healedSteps: [] } : {}), ...result };
}

const server = new McpServer({
  name: "Customer Desk",
  version: "1.0.0"
});

// Tool: add_customer_note (from workflow: "Add customer note")
server.tool(
  "add_customer_note",
  "Add customer note Runs in the browser (no recorded HTTP request).\n\nOptional reserved argument _timeoutMs (integer, 1 to 600000): timeout in milliseconds of the whole call; it is not part of the payload.",
  {
    // Reserved: the timeout of this call. Never part of the inferred payload schema.
    "_timeoutMs": z.number().int().min(1).max(600000).optional(),
  },
  async ({ _timeoutMs, ...args }) => {
    // The payload is validated against the full inferred schema before any replay.
    const errors = validatePayload("add_customer_note", args);
    if (errors !== null) {
      return {
        content: [{ type: "text", text: JSON.stringify(withMode({ success: false, error: "validation", errors })) }],
        isError: true
      };
    }
    const result = await runReplay([{"actionType":"type","selectors":["input[name=\"note\"]"],"variable":"note","value":"hello world","label":"Note","anchor":{"role":"textbox","name":"Note","frame":[]},"risk":"write"},{"actionType":"select","selectors":["select[name=\"plan\"]"],"variable":"plan","value":"pro","label":"Plan","anchor":{"role":"combobox","name":"Plan","frame":[]},"risk":"write"},{"actionType":"click","selectors":["tr button"],"label":"Open","anchor":{"role":"button","name":"Open","frame":[]},"rowBinding":{"container":{"kind":"row","role":"row"},"key":{"text":"Ada Lovelace","column":"Name"},"variable":"customer"},"risk":"read"},{"actionType":"click","selectors":["#save"],"label":"Save","anchor":{"role":"button","name":"Save","frame":[]},"risk":"write"}], args, {"workflowId":"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111101"}, { callMs: _timeoutMs, workflowMs: undefined, setMs: undefined });
    return {
      content: [{ type: "text", text: JSON.stringify(withMode(result)) }],
      isError: !result.success
    };
  }
);

// Tool: add_note_by_api (from workflow: "Add note by API")
server.tool(
  "add_note_by_api",
  "Add note by API Runs over HTTP, without a browser.\n\nOptional reserved argument _timeoutMs (integer, 1 to 600000): timeout in milliseconds of the whole call; it is not part of the payload.",
  {
    // Reserved: the timeout of this call. Never part of the inferred payload schema.
    "_timeoutMs": z.number().int().min(1).max(600000).optional(),
  },
  async ({ _timeoutMs, ...args }) => {
    // The payload is validated against the full inferred schema before any replay.
    const errors = validatePayload("add_note_by_api", args);
    if (errors !== null) {
      return {
        content: [{ type: "text", text: JSON.stringify(withMode({ success: false, error: "validation", errors })) }],
        isError: true
      };
    }
    const result = await runReplay([{"actionType":"type","selectors":["input[name=\"note\"]"],"variable":"note","value":"from the API","label":"Note","anchor":{"role":"textbox","name":"Note","frame":[]},"risk":"write"},{"actionType":"click","selectors":["#save"],"label":"Save","anchor":{"role":"button","name":"Save","frame":[]},"risk":"write","http":{"method":"POST","url":"https://desk.example.test/api/customers/{{customer}}/notes","query":{"source":"desk"},"body":{"text":{"$var":"note"},"kind":"note"},"bodyFormat":"json","headers":{"accept":"application/json"},"auth":"none","expectStatus":201,"bindings":[{"variable":"customer","in":"path","name":"customer"},{"variable":"note","in":"body","name":"text"}],"redacted":[]}}], args, {"workflowId":"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111102"}, { callMs: _timeoutMs, workflowMs: undefined, setMs: undefined });
    return {
      content: [{ type: "text", text: JSON.stringify(withMode(result)) }],
      isError: !result.success
    };
  }
);

// Tool: refresh_the_list (from workflow: "Refresh the list")
server.tool(
  "refresh_the_list",
  "Refresh the list Runs in the browser (no recorded HTTP request).\n\nOptional reserved argument _timeoutMs (integer, 1 to 600000): timeout in milliseconds of the whole call; it is not part of the payload.",
  {
    // Reserved: the timeout of this call. Never part of the inferred payload schema.
    "_timeoutMs": z.number().int().min(1).max(600000).optional(),
  },
  async ({ _timeoutMs, ...args }) => {
    // The payload is validated against the full inferred schema before any replay.
    const errors = validatePayload("refresh_the_list", args);
    if (errors !== null) {
      return {
        content: [{ type: "text", text: JSON.stringify(withMode({ success: false, error: "validation", errors })) }],
        isError: true
      };
    }
    const result = await runReplay([{"actionType":"click","selectors":["#refresh"],"label":"Refresh","anchor":{"role":"button","name":"Refresh","frame":[]},"risk":"read"}], args, {"workflowId":"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111103"}, { callMs: _timeoutMs, workflowMs: undefined, setMs: undefined });
    return {
      content: [{ type: "text", text: JSON.stringify(withMode(result)) }],
      isError: !result.success
    };
  }
);

const transport = new StdioServerTransport();
await server.connect(transport);
